title: Salty Air & Blue Mountain Flair
meta_description: Salty Air \& Blue Mountain Flair is a stylish 3BR/3BA condo in Redfish Village with pool, hot tub, private beach access, and coastal charm---your perfect escape in Blue Mountain Beach.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Salty Air \& Blue Mountain Flair, a beautifully appointed 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom condo located in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach along scenic 30A. Nestled in the coveted Redfish Village, this serene and spacious escape offers the perfect blend of coastal charm and modern convenience---ideal for families, couples, or anyone seeking a peaceful beach getaway.

Step inside to discover a bright and airy open-concept layout, where natural light pours through oversized windows. The cozy living area is tastefully decorated with beachy elegance, featuring comfortable seating, a flat-screen TV, and easy access to the private balcony. Adjacent to the living room is a fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and a large dining area perfect for shared meals or game nights.

Each of the three bedrooms is designed with relaxation in mind. The primary suite includes a luxurious en-suite bathroom with dual vanities and a soaking tub. The additional bedrooms are equally inviting, with cozy beds, ample storage, and beautifully updated bathrooms to accommodate guests in comfort.

Outside, enjoy the spacious private deck---ideal for morning coffee, evening cocktails, or just soaking in the Florida sunshine. When you're ready to explore, Redfish Village offers resort-style amenities, including:

- A sparkling community pool
- Playground for the little ones
- Nature boardwalks and trails
- Private beach access via a dedicated shuttle or boardwalk
- Outdoor lounge areas, BBQ stations, and shaded seating.

BEACH ACCESS: Located just one block off the beach.

Whether you're here to unwind, explore, or reconnect, Redfish Retreat is your gateway to the very best of 30A!

Redfish Village is located in the charming community of Blue Mountain Beach, Florida---renowned for its sugar-white sand and stunning emerald waters. This picturesque coastal town in South Walton offers the perfect blend of natural beauty and laid-back luxury.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach.

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- Open parking lot. First come, first serve.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
